description: Tarif Unifié sur les Bornes Electriques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Association des Utilisateurs de Bornes Electriques 2016-2021. The AUBE association proposes to planners and network managers a harmonization of their tariffs on public charging stations. Thus a user will be able to pay his charge according to a unified tariff on the national territory whatever the network used. Coverage: Association des Utilisateurs de Bornes Electriques 2016-2021. The portal shows the English title as "Unified Rate on Electric Terminals" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Association des Utilisateurs de Bornes Electriques 2016-2021. Its keywords include aube, tarif, tarif-unifie, vehicule-electrique, borne-de-rechargement-electrique, station-de-recharge. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GOOGLE DRIVE. The listing shows 2020-02-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
